text:
𝗗𝗘 𝗦𝗜𝗟𝗩𝗔 𝗧𝗢𝗡! 🇱🇰

Dhananjaya de Silva 114* off 166 as Sri Lanka reach 303/4 in Rawalpindi.
Still 131 behind Pakistan's 434/9d, follow-on avoided.

Can SL take the lead? 👇

#PAKvSL #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗗𝗘 𝗦𝗜𝗟𝗩𝗔 𝗞𝗔 𝗦𝗘𝗡𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗬! 🇱🇰🔥

👉 Dhananjaya de Silva 114* (166 balls, 13 chauke) Rawalpindi Test mein
👉 Kusal Mendis 70* ke saath Sri Lanka 303/4
👉 Pakistan ke 434/9d se abhi 131 run peeche, follow-on tala

Kya Sri Lanka lead le payega? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #PAKvSL #TestCricket
